VPNCheck Stand\n\nТелефоны на кабеле как:
VPNCheck Stand

Phones on a cable as a stand for testing VPN nodes: xray runs on the phone over ADB, traffic goes out through its network (SIM or Wi-Fi), the result is a column per network. Several phones are checked at the same time.

The DC check runs from your own server over SSH (File → Connections).

How to connect a new phone - see the "Help" menu.
